gate_results.rationale: Applying the IT gate rule to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_IT snapshot at phase 'opportunity': catalog_status='approved_exception' with waiver_present=true (no IT-CATALOG-001); duplicate_capability=false (no IT-RATIONAL-001); license_compliant=true (no IT-LICENSE-001); cmdb_record_present=true (no IT-CMDB-001); run_owner_present=false but phase is 'opportunity', not build_acceptance/deployment_closure, so IT-RUN-001 is not applicable; capacity_headroom_pct=15 is not <15 and phase predicate fails (no IT-CAPACITY-001); change_record_status='scheduled' and phase != deployment_closure (no IT-CHANGE-001). The only triggered finding is IT-EOL-001: technology_eol_months=4 < 12, requiring a convergence plan (REWORK). REWORK is not in authorization_required_for, so no authorization is required.

Applying the architecture gate rule (DGF-decision-v8) to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_ARCHITECTURE snapshot at phase 'design': ip_overlap=false (no ARCH-IP-001; confirmed by IP_PLAN showing overlap_detected=False for 10.166.160.0/24, .161.0/24, .162.0/24). api_gateway_required=true and api_gateway_present=true (no ARCH-API-001). data_owner_present=true and data_lineage_complete=true (no ARCH-DATA-001). measured_latency_ms=30 is not > latency_target_ms=50 (no ARCH-PERF-001). business_criticality='High' but architecture_profile.multi_az=true, so the no-redundancy predicate fails (no ARCH-HA-001); HLD corroborates 'single_region_multi_az' and 'Multi-AZ' placement across three zones. The only triggered finding is ARCH-REV-001: reversibility_status='draft' -> medium, action COMPLETE_EXIT_ARCHITECTURE, disposition GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, risk_acceptance_allowed=True. This finding is within the active standing mandate (MANDATE-...-BUILD-02-ARCHITECTURE-1, scope 'all and only risk-acceptable findings'), and an authorized conditional approval was executed (APPROVE_WITH_CONDITIONS, EXECUTED). GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS is in authorization_required_for, hence authorization_required=true. Proposed conditions/actions are not completed remediation.

Applying the DGF-decision-v8 security rule to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_SECURITY snapshot at phase 'design': (1) internet_exposed=true with waf_present=true and waf_mode='Detection' triggers SEC-WAF-002 (high, ENABLE_WAF_PREVENTION), corroborated by WAF_POLICY mode='Detection' with bot_protection=false; (2) data_classification='Confidential' with private_endpoints=false triggers SEC-NET-001 (critical, ENABLE_PRIVATE_ENDPOINTS), corroborated by AZURE_RESOURCE_GRAPH showing 'private_endpoints': false and publicNetworkAccess=true on the SQL Database and Storage Account; (3) critical_vulns_open=1 (>0) triggers SEC-VULN-001 (critical, REMEDIATE_CRITICAL_VULNERABILITIES), corroborated by VULN_SCAN listing CVE-2026-8000 severity 'Critical' status 'Open'. Non-triggered predicates confirmed: mfa='mandatory' (no SEC-IAM-001); shared_service_principal=false and IAM_EXPORT shows only a single ManagedIdentity assignment (no SEC-IAM-002); logs_to_siem=true and SENTINEL_STATUS confirms sentinel/logs_to_siem true (no SEC-LOG-001); key_rotation_days=180 not in (None,365) (no SEC-KEY-001); phase='design' so the build_acceptance pentest predicate does not apply (no SEC-PENTEST-001). The two critical findings carry disposition NO_GO and risk_acceptance_allowed=false, so the gate outcome is NO_GO. NO_GO is in authorization_required_for, hence authorization_required=true. Proposed actions are remediation proposals, not completed remediation.

Applying the DGF-decision-v8 tech-readiness rule to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_TECH_READINESS snapshot at phase 'build_acceptance': (1) restore_tested=false triggers TR-RESTORE-001 (high, REWORK, RUN_RESTORE_TEST); because the restore was never tested, the 'elif measured_restore_hours > target_rto_hours' branch is not evaluated, so TR-RTO-001 does not fire despite measured_restore_hours=3.5 > target_rto_hours=2; (2) critical_static_findings=2 > 0 triggers TR-CODE-001 (high, REWORK, REMEDIATE_BUILD_FINDINGS), corroborated by CI_PIPELINE reporting critical_static_findings=2; (3) runbook_status='missing' != 'approved' triggers TR-OPS-001 (medium, GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, COMPLETE_OPERATIONAL_HANDOVER), corroborated by the non-authoritative RUNBOOK showing 'Runbook status | None' — the authoritative snapshot value 'missing' governs. Non-triggered predicates confirmed: backup_enabled=true and BACKUP_JOBS shows enabled=True/last_status=Succeeded (no TR-BACKUP-001); measured_data_loss_minutes=30 is not > target_rpo_minutes=30 (no TR-RPO-001); dr_required=false per both snapshot and FAILOVER_TEST (no TR-DR-001); load_test_pct_of_peak=150 is not < 100 (no TR-LOAD-001); rollback_tested=true (no TR-ROLLBACK-001); open_blockers=0 (no TR-BLOCKER-001). Highest-priority triggered disposition is REWORK (two high-severity REWORK findings), so the gate outcome is REWORK. REWORK is not in authorization_required_for, so authorization_required=false; the standing mandate covers only risk-acceptable findings and no risk acceptance is requested. Proposed actions are remediation proposals, not completed remediation.
